#compdef jet
# zsh completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions zsh`)
_jet() {
local -a commands flags
commands=(
        'registry:Publish and manage packages'
        'db:Run a bounded SQL console and manage database migrations'
        'inspect:Explore code, builds, packages, and bindings'
        'bind:Resolve and record a checked foreign binding plan'
        'project:Inspect project files and modules'
        'self:Manage the Jet installation and editor tools'
        'diff:Compare two Jet programs by meaning'
        'merge:Merge Jet programs without losing code structure'
        'review:Review meaning, authority, and proof changes'
        'run:Run a program or project'
        'jobs:List, inspect, watch, or run named project jobs'
        'generate:Run an explicit source generator with authority and a receipt'
        'check:Check code without creating a binary'
        'fill:Propose checked code for typed goals'
        'test:Run tests'
        'test-compare:Compare one recorded observation corpus against its relation'
        'prove:Create a proof report for code and tests'
        'status:Show what the project has proved'
        'build:Create a native executable'
        'package:Create a desktop or game application bundle'
        'flash:Flash firmware to a target board'
        'cc:Compile and link C with the pinned Jetpack toolchain'
        'c++:Compile and link C++ with the pinned Jetpack toolchain'
        'dev:Watch and run a program; optionally open Canvas or a local app'
        'learn:Practice Jet with offline code exercises'
        'try:Speculatively apply a plan and re-check its claims'
        'debug:Debug a program from Jet source'
        'repl:Try Jet code interactively'
        'notebook:Open a Jet notebook (.jetnb) or Jupyter adapter'
        'import:Convert supported source code into editable Jet'
        'new:Create a Jet project or backend source scaffold'
        'fmt:Format Jet and configured project files'
        'fix:Apply safe automatic fixes, including `fix memory`'
        'audit:Inspect implicit copies, exercised memory witnesses, or dependencies'
        'lint:Run optional code-quality checks'
        'doc:Generate reference documentation'
        'explain:Explain a diagnostic code, build fact, generic-module value, or typed cost'
        'env:Open the project development shell'
        'shared-store:Manage the optional shared package broker'
        'cache:Manage the machine-wide artifact store'
        'remote:Manage host-owned remote builders'
        'trust:Review or change trusted authority'
        'image:Build a declared container image'
        'os:Manage Jetos machines and images'
        'add:Add and download a dependency'
        'remove:Remove a dependency'
        'fetch:Download locked dependencies'
        'search:Search the local package catalog'
        'find:Find code by type, effect, or example'
        'update:Update dependency or toolchain pins'
        'init:Create package settings in this directory'
        'split:Extract closed Package facts into Configs or members'
        'Fold:Reverse a recorded Package source transition'
        'gc:Show values moved into automatic memory management'
        'clean:Remove unused package-store data'
        'emit:Print generated build output'
        'eval:Evaluate pure Jet and print the value (`--json` for JSON)'
        'budget:Check performance limits or update baselines'
        'perf:Collect and inspect performance traces'
        'fuzz:Find failing inputs for property tests'
        'version:Show the Jet version'
        'help:Show command help'
    )
flags=(
        '--live[With inspect\: Process id for a live plane scope]'
        '--observe[With run\: Expose bounded live runtime facts for attachment]'
        '--raw-frames[With debug\: Show generated Rust frames and scopes (expert)]'
        '--dap[With debug\: Speak the Debug Adapter Protocol over stdio]'
        '--gc-trace[With run/dev\: Record bounded automatic GC-promotion evidence]'
        '--structural[With diff/merge\: Compare checked definitions by semantic identity]'
        '--base-receipt[With review\: Proof receipt for the base change-set side]'
        '--receipt[With review\: Proof receipt for the reviewed change-set side]'
        '--out[With structural merge\: Write the checked result to this path]'
        '--repo[With merge install-driver\: Git worktree to configure]'
        '--json[Emit machine-readable facts or diagnostics]'
        '--topic[With inspect digest\: Emit one digest topic]'
        '--to[With publish/cache/db migrate\: Foreign registry, prune target size, or migration target version]'
        '--list-topics[With inspect digest\: List digest topics]'
        '--kind[With inspect gates/package\: Filter one gate or bundle kind]'
        '--quiet[Suppress non-error status output]'
        '--color[Color\: auto | always | never]'
        '--version[With package/new\: Set bundle or migration version; global flag prints compiler version]'
        '--endpoint[With self-update\: Signed toolchain channel endpoint]'
        '--channel[With self-update\: Toolchain channel name]'
        '--platform[With self-update\: Toolchain target triple]'
        '--trust-key[With self-update\: Public trust-key file]'
        '--apply[With self-update/generate/new\: Apply the verified artifact or planned source writes]'
        '--preview[With new\: Preview deterministic backend source writes without applying them]'
        '--remove[With new\: Remove only unchanged outputs recorded by the scaffold receipt]'
        '--path[With new\: Route or output path, defaulting to `/<name>`]'
        '--route[With new\: Alias for `--path`]'
        '--model[With new\: Model name recorded beside the route source]'
        '--allow-unofficial[With self-update\: Explicitly allow a local keyless channel]'
        '--check[With fmt/learn\: Check without changing files (CI gate)]'
        '--lang[With fmt\: Delegate non-Jet files to the environment formatter for this language]'
        '--restore-role-files[With init\: Restore the exact pre-package.jet role files]'
        '--diff[With fmt --check\: Also print unified diffs for each changed file]'
        '--simplify[With fmt\: Rewrite to the simplest ratified spelling]'
        '--changed[With fmt\: Format only VCS-changed .jet files (requires git)]'
        '--explicit-copies[With fmt\: Materialize implicit read-view copies as `~`]'
        '--skipped[With project parts\: Show modules omitted from automatic discovery]'
        '--stdin-path[With fmt -\: Path label used in diagnostics when reading from stdin]'
        '--small[With build/run/jobs\: Favor a smaller binary]'
        '--lib[With build\: Emit the native Library and C header]'
        '--output[With build/run/dev/jobs/package\: Select a named output (build --lib selects a Library; Canvas uses it as the initial selection)]'
        '--locked[With build/fetch/jobs/run\: Require locked dependency and provenance facts]'
        '--effect[With find\: Require an effect such as FS.Read]'
        '--example[With find\: Search by input/output example]'
        '--lock[With fetch/db migrate/new\: Lock dependency fetching or choose a migration/scaffold lock policy]'
        '--read-only[With shared-store enroll\: Grant read-only broker access]'
        '--host[With cache limit\: Host-wide store cap]'
        '--fd[With shared-store broker\: Inherited broker socket descriptor]'
        '-p[With run/dev/debug/check/build/jobs\: Pick a workspace member by name]'
        '--annotated[With new\: Include commented example deps]'
        '--force[With publish\: Bypass pre-publish gate (with warning)]'
        '--no-sign[With publish\: Skip the optional author signature (registry metadata is still signed)]'
        '--registry[With keygen/key\: Registry name to generate or manage a signing key for]'
        '--pkg[With bind\: Library name for the generated binding module]'
        '--shape[With bind\: Binding facade shape\: automatic or native]'
        '--freeze[With bind\: Record the resolved binding plan in the project lock]'
        '--policy[With bind\: Binding policy\: automatic or frozen]'
        '--accept[With bind --update\: Accept exactly this candidate plan digest]'
        '--import[With build\: Import and inspect an existing foreign build graph]'
        '--clang[With bind cpp\: Path to the clang binary used to parse the header]'
        '--ar[With bind cpp\: Path to the ar archiver used to build the static library]'
        '--before[With schema squash\: Re-baseline migrations before this version]'
        '--spdx[With sbom\: Emit SPDX tag-value format (default)]'
        '--cyclonedx[With sbom\: Emit CycloneDX JSON format]'
        '--advisory-db[With audit\: Path to advisory database file]'
        '--vendor-dir[With vendor\: Directory to copy dependencies into (default vendor/)]'
        '--sbom[With build\: Also write an SPDX SBOM next to the binary]'
        '--verbose[With build/jobs\: Print the bridge steps; with check\: print the status line, proof rows, and receipt notices; with run/dev/test\: show advisory lints; with explain\: show a syntax token'\''s registry name and decision]'
        '--template[With new\: Start from a named template\: cli, ui, web, or overrides]'
        '--sort[With help\: Order commands by use (frequency, the default), A to Z (az), or Z to A (za)]'
        '--online[With doctor\: Allow network checks]'
        '--fix[With doctor\: Apply auto-fixable problems]'
        '--dry-run[With package/rewrite commands/generate\: Preview changes without writing]'
        '--entry[With generate\: Source file containing the generator job]'
        '--keep[With try\: Keep a clean speculative edit]'
        '--edition[With fix\: Apply edition migration rewrites --edition=<year>]'
        '--all[With fix\: Apply safety classes beyond formatting and behavior-preserving]'
        '--try-anyway[With dev\: Interpret past unsupported features (no guarantees)]'
        '--interpret[With dev/jobs\: Force the tier-0 TIR interpreter]'
        '--trace-tiers[With run/dev\: Print per-function Cranelift vs interpreter tier selection; with test\: print AOT marker]'
        '--restart[With dev\: Always rerun from scratch after a save]'
        '--swap[With dev\: Hot-swap compatible edits and restart after type changes]'
        '--reload[With explain\: Explain the checked reload decision for a source or project path]'
        '--watch[With run/dev/learn/test/jobs\: Re-run on dependency changes; test default off with r=failed, a=all, o=output; jobs accepts --watch\[=<on|off>\]; --watch=off runs once]'
        '--graph[With jobs\: Show the checked job dependency graph]'
        '--status[With jobs\: Show fresh or stale status for declared jobs]'
        '--explain[With jobs/package\: Explain dependencies, phases, cache identity, and admission facts]'
        '--canvas[With dev\: Open the full Canvas IDE over this dev session]'
        '--app[With dev\: Select a checked local-app function]'
        '--share[With dev\: Select local-app sharing authority\: loopback or lan]'
        '--canvas-host[With dev\: With --canvas, bind host (loopback by default)]'
        '--canvas-port[With dev\: With --canvas, bind an explicit port]'
        '--canvas-transport[With dev\: With --canvas, select the named transport]'
        '--canvas-authority[With dev\: With --canvas, select loopback or remote authority]'
        '--canvas-audit[With dev\: With --canvas, enable request/rebuild audit output]'
        '--project[With repl\: Load package settings and imports from this directory]'
        '--console[With repl\: Open the project-loaded capability-gated console]'
        '--sandbox[With repl\: Use the reversible data sandbox (`--sandbox data`)]'
        '--console-ttl[With repl\: Expire console authority after this many milliseconds]'
        '--protocol[With notebook\: Use the bounded headless JSONL/script session]'
        '--headless[With notebook\: Use the bounded headless session]'
        '--bind[With notebook\: Bind the local HTTP client to this address]'
        '--token[With notebook/dev\: Require a bearer token for the session]'
        '--no-prepare[With run\: Refuse Jetpack project environment preparation]'
        '--pure[With eval\: Reject code with side effects]'
        '--allow[With run/build/jobs/repl/db\: Allow comma-separated effect roots or leaves as --allow=RIGHTS]'
        '--deny[With run/build/jobs/repl/db\: Deny comma-separated effect roots or leaves as --deny=RIGHTS]'
        '--offline[With env/run/dev/test/cc/c++\: Reuse only cached signed toolchain and package data]'
        '--fixtures[With env/run/dev/test/cc/c++\: Use an explicit fixture bundle]'
        '--project-root[With cc/c++\: Scope source paths to a project directory]'
        '--build-root[With cc/c++\: Scope output paths to a build directory]'
        '-c[With cc/c++\: Compile sources without linking]'
        '-o[With cc/c++\: Choose the output path]'
        '-MMD[With cc/c++\: Emit user-header dependency data]'
        '-MD[With cc/c++\: Emit dependency data]'
        '-MF[With cc/c++\: Choose the dependency-file path]'
        '-MT[With cc/c++\: Choose the dependency target]'
        '--sysroot[With cc/c++\: Reserved; target selects the pinned sysroot]'
        '-I[With cc/c++\: Add a project-relative include path]'
        '-D[With cc/c++\: Define a preprocessor symbol]'
        '-L[With cc/c++\: Add a project-relative library path]'
        '-l[With cc/c++\: Link a declared library]'
        '-std[With cc/c++\: Select the language standard]'
        '-dumpmachine[With cc/c++\: Print the pinned target triple]'
        '-print-sysroot[With cc/c++\: Print the pinned virtual sysroot]'
        '-dumpversion[With cc/c++\: Print the pinned compiler version]'
        '-v[With cc/c++\: Print pinned toolchain details or compile verbosely]'
        '--gate[With build/run/dev/jobs\: Allow one audited gate as --gate name=allow]'
        '--target[With build/run/dev/jobs/package/cc/c++/flash\: Select a target (triple, board.<name>, or named database target)]'
        '--up[With db migrate/new\: Checked forward SQL]'
        '--sql[With db migrate/new\: Alias for checked forward SQL]'
        '--down[With db migrate/new\: Checked inverse SQL for rollback]'
        '--database[With db migrate\: Project-relative database path (receipt identity is redacted)]'
        '--risk[With db migrate/new\: Data-risk note shown before writes]'
        '--step[With db migrate\: Number of ordered migrations to apply or roll back]'
        '--format[With db\: Output format\: human, text, json, jsonl, or csv]'
        '--csv[With db\: Select deterministic CSV output]'
        '--jsonl[With db\: Emit one JSON value per row]'
        '--machine[With db\: Select machine-readable output]'
        '--human[With db\: Select human-readable output]'
        '--no-color[With db\: Disable color in console output]'
        '--force-color[With db\: Force color in console output]'
        '--query[With db\: Execute one SQL query]'
        '--script[With db\: Execute SQL from a script path]'
        '--table[With db\: Set an explicit table identity as NAME=PATH]'
        '--max-rows[With db\: Bound decoded input rows]'
        '--max-bytes[With db\: Bound source or script bytes]'
        '--max-output-bytes[With db\: Bound one rendered result]'
        '--image[With flash\: Firmware image to program]'
        '--audit[With flash\: Target audit JSON for the image]'
        '--adapter[With flash\: Flash adapter\: probe-rs, openocd, or emulator]'
        '--package[With package\: Set the bundle package identifier]'
        '--name[With package\: Set the bundle executable name]'
        '--executable[With package\: Path to the executable to bundle]'
        '--icon[With package\: Path to the bundle icon]'
        '--icon-format[With package\: Icon format\: png, icns, ico, or svg]'
        '--icon-size[With package\: Icon size in pixels]'
        '--publisher[With package\: Publisher metadata]'
        '--description[With package\: Application description metadata]'
        '--update-channel[With package\: Updater channel]'
        '--update-url[With package\: Updater URL]'
        '--game[With package\: Build a game bundle]'
        '--source[With package\: Project source or package root for a game bundle]'
        '--phase[With package\: Comma-separated game phases\: build, cook, stage, package, export, deploy, run]'
        '--backend[With package\: Game build backend\: aot]'
        '--renderer[With package\: Game renderer authority\: headless or raylib]'
        '--cook[With package\: Alias for --cook-mode]'
        '--cook-mode[With package\: Asset cooking mode\: fast, reproducible, or scripts-only]'
        '--export[With package\: Export phase or named export preset]'
        '--export-preset[With package\: Named export preset\: default, store, or headless]'
        '--deploy[With package\: Include the deploy phase]'
        '--deploy-to[With package\: Explicit deployment destination]'
        '--crash-reporter[With package\: Crash reporter policy\: off, on, or opt-in]'
        '--crash-consent[With package\: Crash reporter consent\: not-requested, granted, or denied]'
        '--cancel[With package\: Cancel owned game staging]'
        '--resume[With package\: Resume an owned game stage]'
        '--clean[With package\: Force-clean owned game cache/staging]'
        '--force-clean[With package\: Alias for --clean]'
        '--scripts-only[With package\: Cook only script assets]'
        '--run-now[With package\: Explicitly opt into the run phase]'
        '--run[With package\: Include the run phase]'
        '--env[With env/run/dev/test\: Select one declared env.<name> module]'
        '--preset[With env/run/dev/test\: Select one declared environment preset]'
        '--explain-partition[With build --target=web\: Show which code becomes JavaScript or WebAssembly]'
        '--fresh[With test\: Bypass only cached test results (default off); the build cache remains reusable]'
        '--docs[With test\: Run checked documentation examples only (default off)]'
        '--where[With test\: Filter recorded package, dependency, path, tag, or status facts (default all) as --where=<expr>]'
        '--capture[With test\: Capture output as failed, all, or none (default failed); watch key o cycles it]'
        '--no-capture[With dev\: Disable automatic replay capture for this session]'
        '--update-snapshots[With test\: Replace expected snapshot output]'
        '--update[With import\: Merge generated Jet into an existing target]'
        '--coverage[With test/inspect build\: Show function or diagnostic coverage]'
        '--verify[With build\: Rebuild and compare one indexed receipt artifact]'
        '--rust[With emit\: Print generated Rust source]'
        '--emit-generated[With build\: Copy generated Jet sources into `.jet/generated/`]'
        '-u[Short form of --update-snapshots]'
        '--release[With build/run/dev/jobs/test\: Optimize for release]'
        '--profile[With build/run/dev/jobs/package/test\: How hard to optimize\: release, debug, ci, hardened, or a named optimization bundle]'
        '--set[With build/run/dev/jobs/test\: Set one declared package setting as key=value]'
        '--builder[With build/jobs\: Select a previously bound remote builder]'
        '--a11y[With lint\: Check roles, labels, and other accessibility basics]'
        '--complexity[With lint\: Report per-function cognitive complexity]'
        '--cost[With lint/explain\: Show typed hidden-copy and fallback costs]'
        '--max[With lint --complexity\: Fail when a function exceeds this score]'
        '--scope[With inspect\: Choose a ledger or trust scope]'
        '--core[With inspect structure\: Show the canonical core module export facts]'
        '--filter[With test\: Only run claims whose name contains --filter=<substr>]'
        '--grade[With test\: Select the generated property-test grade as --grade=generated]'
        '--shuffle[With test\: Run tests in random (or --shuffle=<seed>) order]'
        '--serial[With test\: Run tests one at a time instead of the parallel default]'
        '--show-default[With run/build/dev/test\: Use and report the stock default]'
        '--measure[With test\: Measure `.measure` claims]'
        '--browser[With test/db\: Select browser engines for tests or serve a loopback database inspector]'
        '--browser-retries[With test\: Retry each browser attempt up to five times]'
        '--browser-reporter[With test\: Browser report format\: text, json, or html]'
        '--browser-ui[With test\: Write/open the local browser report viewer]'
        '--browser-visual[With test\: Capture screenshots for passing browser attempts]'
        '--browser-trace[With test\: Keep redacted BiDi trace entries for every browser attempt]'
        '--browser-scaffold[With test\: Create an isolated browser-test project as --browser-scaffold=<name>]'
        '--record[With run/dev/test/debug\: Record a named replay as --record=<name>]'
        '--replay[With inspect/debug\: Consume a named replay artifact]'
        '--iterations[With fuzz\: Case budget --iterations=<n> (default 1000)]'
        '--time[With fuzz\: Wall-clock budget in seconds --time=<n>]'
        '--seed[With fuzz\: Base PRNG seed --seed=<n> (default\: fixed, reproducible)]'
        '--corpus[With fuzz\: Corpus directory --corpus=<dir> (default\: .jet/fuzz/<test>)]'
        '--lens[With prove\: Project the human report by an exact evidence facet]'
        '--facts[With expand\: Project inline, memory, web, effects, layout, derive, templates, or callable-signature facts --facts=<lens>]'
        '--annotations[With budget\: CI annotations auto, none, or github]'
        '--baseline[With budget update\: Selected baseline name]'
        '--bootstrap[With budget update\: Create absent or stale baseline history]'
        '--accept-regression[With budget update\: Explicitly accept a regression]'
        '--reason[With exceptional budget update\: Checked-in reason]'
        '--yes[With budget update\: Apply a valid non-interactive plan]'
        '-y[Short form of --yes]'
    )
if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
_describe -t commands 'command' commands
elif (( CURRENT == 3 && $words[2] == jobs )); then
        local -a job_names
job_names=("${(@f)$(jet --json jobs 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"name":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')}")
_describe -t job_names 'job' job_names
    else
if (( CURRENT == 3 )); then
case $words[2] in
            registry) _values 'action' 'publish:Publish the current package' 'yank:Stop new installs of a published version' 'keygen:Create a package-signing key' 'key:Manage the package-signing key' 'vendor:Copy dependencies into vendor/' ;;
            db) _values 'action' 'migrate:Create, preview, inspect, apply, resume, and roll back versioned database migrations' ;;
            inspect) _values 'action' 'types:Show registered type and operator facts' 'rights:Show required and granted rights' 'claims:Show receipt-backed claims' 'shapes:Show semantic shapes and projections' 'accel:Show vector proof and acceleration gate decisions' 'decisions:Show compiler decisions and their evidence' 'structure:Show structure and lifecycle facts' 'build:Show build identity, provenance, and coverage' 'gates:Show the complete compile-time gate ledger' 'graph:Show the build graph' 'query:Search code and build information' 'explain-build:Explain why a target, action, or file is rebuilt' 'compiler:Read compiler facts as versioned JSON' 'impact:Show code affected by a symbol' 'provenance:Read dependency provenance' 'digest:Write the one-file LLM surface digest' 'env:List typed environment reads in a config surface' 'semindex:Search the code index' 'output:Inspect one selected Output' 'expand:Show expanded meaning of Jet code (use --json for canonical facts)' 'schema:Inspect saved data schema versions' 'codemod:Preview or apply code changes' 'audit:Inspect implicit copies, exercised memory witnesses, or dependencies' 'sbom:Create a software bill of materials' 'bind:Generate Jet bindings from a foreign header' 'logs:Show recent package build logs' 'info:Show package details' 'outdated:List dependencies with available updates' 'reserved:List reserved words and sigils' ;;
            project) _values 'action' 'parts:List loaded and skipped project modules' ;;
            self) _values 'action' 'toolchain:Show the Jet version selected for this project' 'update:Verify or install a signed Jet toolchain release' 'doctor:Find and fix toolchain problems' 'completions:Print shell completions' 'man:Print the Jet manual' 'devtools:Run Jet maintenance tools' 'lsp:Start the language server' 'exec:Execute one command in an authority-bound workspace' ;;
            env) _values 'action' 'test:Run environment checks in a clean environment' 'hook:Print the shell auto-activation hook' 'sync:Apply typed managed environment files' 'info:Show the typed environment plan' ;;
            shared-store) _values 'action' 'install:Install the optional shared package broker' 'enroll:Grant a user shared-store broker access' 'status:Show shared-store broker configuration' 'broker:Serve one shared-store broker request' ;;
            cache) _values 'action' 'status:Show machine-wide artifact store usage' 'prune:Prune the artifact store to a target size' 'limit:Set the host-wide artifact store limit' ;;
            os) _values 'action' 'push:Deploy one or more Jetos machines' 'bridge:Convert an existing system configuration to Jet' 'services:Manage development services' 'config:Manage Jet settings and trust' ;;
            gc) _values 'action' 'report:Show values moved into automatic memory management' ;;
            perf) _values 'action' 'run:Run a program and write a .jettrace' 'test:Run tests and write a .jettrace' 'attach:Attach to a running process and write a .jettrace' 'view:Show a .jettrace summary' 'compare:Compare two .jettrace artifacts' 'export:Export a loss-declared projection of a .jettrace' ;;
            esac
else
_values 'flag' $flags
_files
fi
fi
}
_jet "$@"
